_comment: ccBar configuration. Copy to ~/.claude/ccbar.config.json. All fields optional — missing keys fall back to defaults.

segments._comment: Toggle each display segment on or off. duration: how long the session has run, after the cost.

bar._comment: The fill/empty characters can be any UTF-8 glyph or ASCII fallback.

thresholds._comment: Percentages. green up to this value, yellow up to the next, red above yellow.

colors._comment: Valid values: reset bold black red green yellow blue magenta cyan white gray. bar_empty: null uses the fill color. cost is used below cost.thresholds.yellow; duration colors the session running time. cache_warm and cache_cold color the prompt cache group.

cost._comment: Cost display is an estimate only and does not reflect your billed charge.

thresholds._comment: USD. Below yellow uses colors.cost, from yellow colors.bar_yellow, from red colors.bar_red.

retro._comment: Session retro. Fires once per session when context reaches threshold_tokens OR threshold_pct of the model's window, whichever comes first. The Stop hook then tells Claude to run the session-retro skill.

handoff._comment: Fires once per session when context reaches threshold_tokens OR threshold_pct, whichever comes first. The Stop hook then tells Claude to run the session-handoff skill.
handoff.prompt_template: Read and execute this plan at: {path}

git._comment: timeout_ms: per-command git timeout in milliseconds. cache_ttl_ms: how long a git result is reused before git runs again. dirty_marker: text shown after the branch when there are uncommitted or untracked changes.

icons._comment: branch: glyph before branch name (empty string = no icon). folder: glyph before folder name (empty string = no icon). dirty: glyph used instead of git.dirty_marker when set (null = use dirty_marker). worktree: glyph before the worktree name (empty string = "wt "). ascii_fallback: force plain-text icons.

rate_limits._comment: show_reset: show time left until each 5h/7d window resets. Rate limits appear only for Pro/Max plans, after the first response.

guards._comment: Opt-in guard hooks, registered by install.py --guards. line_endings: after Edit/Write, block when a tracked file's line endings no longer match git's checkout form. posted_text: before a gh/az command that posts text, block when it or a body file it references contains a banned entry (literal substrings; your list replaces the default). build_gate: before git push or gh pr create, build the project roots touched by unpushed commits and block on a failed build; empty builds means off; see the README for the row format.
